# Comprehensive Manager Portal Quality Checklist: Manager Portal Upgrade & Authentication

**Purpose**: Validate specification completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability across security, UX flows, and API integrations prior to task decomposition and implementation.  
**Created**: 2026-09-16  
**Feature**: [spec.md](file:///Users/lazolazarev/projects/springboot_rube_goldberg/specs/014-manager-portal-upgrade/spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## 1. Authentication & Role-Based Access Control

- [x] CHK001 Are the OpenID Connect (OIDC) Authorization Code Flow with PKCE parameters and redirect URIs fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK002 Is the exact claim path for role extraction (`realm_access.roles`) explicitly defined in requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-004]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements specified for handling users authenticated with non-manager roles (e.g., `ROLE_CUSTOMER`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §US-1]
- [x] CHK004 Are token refresh behaviors and lead-time thresholds defined for active sessions approaching expiration? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Research §2]
- [x] CHK005 Are session termination requirements explicit regarding local token clearing versus Keycloak SSO session logout? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §US-1]
- [x] CHK006 Is the fallback behavior specified when Keycloak authentication service is unreachable? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-002, §Edge Cases]

## 2. Operational Analytics & KPI Requirements

- [x] CHK007 Are the five mandatory business metrics (Reservations, Cancellations, No-Shows, Waiting List Entries, Conversion Rate) explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §US-2]
- [x] CHK008 Is the default scoping behavior defined when loading analytics (active restaurant vs. platform-wide)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK009 Are scheduled polling intervals and manual refresh mechanisms consistently specified? [Consistency, Spec §US-2]
- [x] CHK010 Are visual error states and retry controls defined for failed analytics fetch operations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §US-2]
- [x] CHK011 Is the calculation or source of the waiting list conversion rate metric documented in requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Data Model]

## 3. Reservation Lifecycle & Back-Filling

- [x] CHK012 Are the permissible status transitions (`ARRIVED`, `COMPLETED`, `NO_SHOW`, `CANCELLED`) explicitly bounded? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Data Model]
- [x] CHK013 Are filtering requirements (by restaurant, by date, by status) unambiguously specified for reservations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §US-3]
- [x] CHK014 Are manager back-filling rules clearly distinguished from customer booking constraints (allowing past-time creation)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §US-3]
- [x] CHK015 Are confirmation requirements and table release semantics defined for reservation cancellations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Contracts §2.3]
- [x] CHK016 Is the behavior specified when attempting to update status on a reservation already in a terminal state? [Edge Case, Gap]

## 4. Restaurant Floor, Tables & Configuration

- [x] CHK017 Are input validation constraints (capacity limits, table number format, zone naming) specified for new dining tables? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Data Model]
- [x] CHK018 Are requirements defined for viewing and updating weekly operating hours per restaurant? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, §US-4]

## 5. Availability & Waiting List Oversight

- [x] CHK021 Are input fields and output slot formatting specified for real-time table availability lookups? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, §US-5]
- [x] CHK022 Are manager privileges for retroactive availability checks explicitly documented? [Consistency, Spec §US-5, §FR-012]
- [x] CHK023 Is the newly authorized `GET /api/v1/waiting-list` endpoint contract fully specified with required query parameters and roles? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, §FR-013, Contracts §2.5]
- [x] CHK024 Is the FIFO queue display ordering (by `createdAt` ASC) explicitly documented in requirements? [Clarity, Spec §US-5, Data Model]
- [x] CHK025 Are zero-state UI requirements defined when no guests are waiting on the queue? [Coverage, Gap]

## 6. Interaction States, UX Resilience & Error Handling

- [x] CHK026 Are loading indicators specified for all asynchronous data fetching and form submission flows? [Completeness, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK027 Are localized error banners specified to prevent portal-wide crashes if an individual downstream microservice fails? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, §SC-006]

- [x] CHK029 Are requirements defined for preserving unsubmitted form inputs if a background token refresh is required? [Resilience, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK030 Are confirmation dialog requirements specified before executing destructive actions (e.g. cancelling a reservation)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, §Edge Cases]
